info.title: World crop cultivation
info.description: Prepared backend contract, schema 32. Not executed or deployed. Bearer authentication required. Commands use server preview, immutable quote and idempotency key. No frontend changes.

get.description: Crop id in this response identifies a crop revision. Select it as crop_revision_id for sowing. No crop content is automatically published.

get.summary: Private state of an owned, unlocked bed
get.description: No writes or timer jobs. Growth pauses at water_due_at if it is earlier than ready_at. ready_at is the stored baseline until overdue watering extends it. A ripe crop does not spoil while inventory is full.

post.description: world_read, world_write, storage_v2; owned active paid bed and membership required. Backpack sources/output use canonical inventory. Sow consumes seeds and initial water. Water is available only when due; missed time extends ready_at. Harvest consumes the cycle only after successful deposit. Cancel has no refund. Preview may show missing materials/output fits=false; execute then rejects atomically.

Requires world-manage. Resources must exist in current craft catalog, active and non-equipment/non-chest. water_item_id=null requires zero water quantity and interval; otherwise both are positive. Existing cycles retain rules. Credits are not minted on harvest; sales are a separate transaction.
